pf2e-artisans-workshop.Downtime.Ahead: {n} days logged ahead of the calendar

pf2e-artisans-workshop.Downtime.Rule: Days count only for characters in downtime. Each day goes to the character's activity: an order they are crafting, an order they help with, an Earn Income job, or something else. Move the calendar forward, or use Advance days, then resolve the days.

pf2e-artisans-workshop.Downtime.PromptOn: {actor} has 1 downtime day to resolve. Open the Workshop's Downtime tab to resolve it.
